test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Her behaviour was __consistent__ even in challenging situations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unpredictable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consistent"** means acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate. (संगत)

 
 
• **Example:** Her **consistent **effort in studies earned her top grades.
 
 
 
• **"Unpredictable"** refers to something not able to be predicted or foreseen; it is the opposite of consistent. (अनिश्चित)
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in the mountains is highly **unpredictable.**
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'consistent'** is **'unpredictable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Unpredictable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Appreciative** (सराहनीय): Showing gratitude or pleasure.

 
 
• **Example:** The audience was appreciative of the artist's performance.
 
 
 
• **Standard** (मानक): A level of quality or attainment.
 
 
• **Example:** His work meets the industry standard.
 
 
 
• **Enthusiastic** (उत्साही): Having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
 
• **Example:** She was enthusiastic about her new job.
 
 

4b:Tc69,

The correct answer is: Option 1
